subject: general
question: P sold an article to Q for Rs. 18000 by losing 20%. Q sells it to R at a price that would have given P a profit of 8%. The profit percentage earned by Q is:
solution:
**Given:**

P sold an article to Q for Rs. 18000 by losing 20%.

Q sells it to R at a price that would have given P a profit of 8%.

**Concept used:**

Cost price - loss = Selling price 

Selling Price (SP) = CP + (Profit /100) × CP

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

Cost price of P = 18000 × 100/80

⇒ Rs 22500

Cost price of R = 22500 × (108/100)

⇒ Rs 24300

Profit earned by Q = 24300 - 18000

⇒ 6300

Profit percentage = (6300 / 18000) × 100

⇒ 35%

**∴ The profit percentage earned by Q is 35%**
